motive.zhHans: 他对White Spirits实施假绑架，是为了就White Spirits领取人身保险赔付，而索要赎金的日期正是White Spirits的毯子被发现的头一天。他之所以会这么做，只可能是因为他知道White Spirits已经死了，因为他的员工向他报告说他们杀死了White Spirits；但White Spirits还活着，因为Saneaki Nagaura、Yasutaka Hase、Masao Shiomi和Chizuru Kakuta把他藏在他们过去工作过的Kitado Stables，White Spirits和White Legion都是在那里出生的，他们没有杀他，而是按照Kozo的White Spirits绑架与谋杀计划行事，并且因为喜爱那匹马，向Tokuyoshi进一步夸大了他们那套令人难以置信的计划。Saneaki Nagaura、Yasutaka Hase、Masao Shiomi和Chizuru Kakuta是被钱收买的，Kozo用钱挖走了他们和White Spirits。Tokuyoshi因一些鲁莽的海外投资而陷入财务困境，于是他决定对White Spirits实施假绑架和谋杀，以欺诈手段获取巨额保险赔付。为了阻止他，他们化了装，并雇用毛利小五郎保护White Spirits。他们假装遵照他的计划行事，实则把White Spirits藏了起来，希望揭出真相，并在Tokuyoshi索要保险金时证明White Spirits安然无恙。

Saneaki Nagaura, Yasutaka Hase, Masao Shiomi and Chizuru Kakuta were bought with money which Kozo poached them and White Spirits. Tokuyoshi was under financial strain because of some reckless foreign investments which he decided to do the fake kidnapping and murder of White Spirits to fraudulently get a huge insurance payout. To stop him they disguised themselves and hired Kogoro to protect White Spirits. They pretended to follow his plan and hide White Spirits instead hoping to reveal the truth and that White Spirits was safe once Tokuyoshi requested the insurance money.

resolution.en: The culprit is Kozo Tokuyoshi. He did the fake kidnapping of White Spirits to get a life insurance policy payout on White Spirits which the date for the money requested was the day before White Spirits blanket was found. He would only do that if he knew White Spirits was dead because his employees reported to him that they killed White Spirits but White Spirits is alive because Saneaki Nagaura, Yasutaka Hase, Masao Shiomi and Chizuru Kakuta hide him at Kitado Stables where they used to work and White Spirits and White Legion were born instead of killing him while acting according to Kozo White Spirits kidnapping and Murder plot and increased there incredibility plot to Tokuyoshi because they loved that horse. They are also the ones who left the anonymous tip. The trailer used to transport White Spirits is at that stables you know. Saneaki Nagaura, Yasutaka Hase, Masao Shiomi and Chizuru Kakuta were bought with money which Kozo poached them and White Spirits. Tokuyoshi was under financial strain because of some reckless foreign investments which he decided to do the fake kidnapping and murder of White Spirits to fraudulently get a huge insurance payout. He used the debts of the employees that they owned to force them to carry out the crime. To stop him they disguised themselves and hired Kogoro to protect White Spirits. With a great detective on the case, they assumed Tokuyoshi would cancel his plans. However, Tokuyoshi believed a famous detective nearby would help him play the victim and carried out his plan. They pretended to follow his plan and hide White Spirits instead hoping to reveal the truth and that White Spirits was safe once Tokuyoshi requested the insurance money. Later White Spirits returned to racing under a new owner.
